"""Dead-lane carrier: the second observation kind.

Measured on this corpus (2026-08-26): ``holds_unreachable`` contributes one
``symbol`` row (module-headed entity ``pkg.dead_kinds:holds_unreachable``)
plus one ``unreachable_statement`` row whose entity carries the region span
suffix — the producer's own ``#start-end`` grammar over the SAME glued head.
"""


def holds_unreachable(value: int) -> int:
    if value > 12:
        return value + 3
    return value - 7
    value *= 2
    return value
